fact: The Computerized Property Tax Administration (CPTA) platform was developed in 2016 for three pilot cities and was never fully implemented, per the LoGRI project page (undated, year 2025 taken from its January 2025 proclamation).

The CPTA assessment is run with the Ministry of Urban and Infrastructure's Urban Revenue Reform Project Office and the Ministry of Finance's Tax Policy Department, with UNECA support; the page is dated 2025 by proxy.

The VNG International-backed ULGE project piloted e-billing and e-payment for property and land lease in Yirgalem city, under an April 2022 agreement with the Sidama Regional State and the municipality; the city then collected only 3 per cent of its potential tax.
The project page says property and land lease processes in Yirgalem were overhauled with e-billing and e-payment after a comprehensive update of property assessments.
